# TripSavvy

> > TripSavvy is a comprehensive travel planning resource offering destination guides, transportation tips, cultural insights, and specialized content for golf enthusiasts and cruise travelers.

TripSavvy provides expert travel advice across global destinations including Spain, South Korea, Italy, and major U.S. cities like New York City. The site features practical guides on transportation (Amtrak, Trenitalia, airlines), destination-specific activities, beach recommendations, tipping etiquette, and specialized golf equipment and tournament format content.

## Key Topics

- Destination Guides
- Transportation Planning
- Beach Destinations
- Cultural Travel
- Golf Equipment & Formats
- Airline Safety & Punctuality
- Cruise Ship Reviews
- Tipping Etiquette
- Train Travel
- Spain & Barcelona
- South Korea & Seoul
- New York City
- Coastal Destinations
- Hotel & Resort Reviews
- Things to Do Guides

- [Amtrak's New Airo Fleet Will Transform US Train Travel as We Know It](https://www.tripsavvy.com/amtrak-just-unveiled-its-new-trains-6951539): Amtrak Airo fleet announcement for 2026 US rail modernization
- [These Are the Safest Airlines in the World for 2023](https://www.tripsavvy.com/safest-airlines-53262): AirlineRatings.com's 2023 safety rankings with Qantas leading
- [Tired of Delays? New Data Shows Which Airline Was the Most on-Time in 2022](https://www.tripsavvy.com/most-on-time-airlines-7091096): Cirium's 2022 airline punctuality rankings with Delta leading
